name: Vitol v Genser Energy Ghana
description: Propane sold on 90-day credit; after a missed invoice due date Vitol terminated and demanded a USD 17,560,514.02 settlement amount, of which USD 3,582,365.95 remained unpaid before a further USD 287,346.69 pre-trial payment, while Genser disputes the due date, the default notice, a June 2018 cargo quantity, late interest and force majeure losses (pack cut down to the key documents; individual invoices summarised in the termination demand).
